title: Threshold progression 4x10min
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 4x10min at 166-174bpm, 3min easy jog between reps, even pace across all 4.
GYM: none.
FUEL: water only, under 90min.
STOP RULE: cut to 3 reps if HR drifts >8bpm above target at the same pace, or RPE hits 8+/10 early.
WHY: progression from last week's 3x8min intro; this is the Build block's main intensity carrier and the tempo engine VWT's flat sections need.
